mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion which may potentiate infliximab-related immunosuppression and increase infection risk; infliximab increases infection susceptibility while thiazide diuretics can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia affecting immune function.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate hydration, and ensure careful infectious disease screening before and during infliximab therapy; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte abnormalities develop.
